excerpt: Observe.AI sells AI agents, agent assist and conversation analytics for customer contact centres. Products, funding and alternatives.
content:
Observe.AI is a software company for customer contact centres. Its site describes purpose-built AI agents in one customer-experience platform: voice AI agents that answer and handle calls, chat agents, real-time assistance for human agents during calls, conversation analytics, automated quality assurance and workflow orchestration, with governance features aimed at large and regulated contact centres. The company is incorporated as Z21 Labs Inc.

On 26 March 2025 Observe.AI made its VoiceAI agents generally available. SiliconANGLE reported that they can handle anything from simple FAQs to multi-step tasks such as booking a flight or renewing a subscription, use a mix of custom and third-party models including small task-specific ones, connect to CRM and help-desk systems through more than 200 prebuilt connectors, remove personal information before storage, and can be deployed as private instances. The company claims the agents can cut contact-centre costs by up to 80% in some cases and says more than 350 organisations use its platform; both are company figures. In November 2025 Gartner named it a Cool Vendor in customer service and support technology. Customer logos on its site include DoorDash, DailyPay, Accolade and JG Wentworth.

Observe.AI raised a $54 million Series B led by Menlo Ventures and, in April 2022, a $125 million Series C led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 with Zoom among the participants, taking its total funding past $210 million. We found no later funding announcement.

Observe.AI does not publish prices; it sells enterprise contracts after a demo. It suits contact centres with dozens to thousands of agents rather than small support teams.

This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting, checked on 15 October 2026. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.
